name: Path of Deities
detailed_description:
In this vertical colossus where divine authority merges with flesh experiments, you are a fugitive of genetic modification wielding forbidden power. Ascend from rusted laboratory depths to cloud-piercing temples—each rescued childhood companion awakens reality-rending abilities, but the deicidal seals in their bones will shackle your choices.

Weave Your Divine Rebellion:
▫️ Cursed Arsenal: Salvage church-forgotten holy shockers and slum-forged acid blades, each whispering its former host’s fractured psyche
▫️ Flesh Alchemy: Brew enhancers from mutant organs and divine crystals—phase through walls as ephemeral mist, or detonate wounds into explosive fury?
▫️ Bloodline Evolution: Redesign your combat form between armored shocktroopers, corrosive symbiotes, and gravity manipulators
▫️ Vertical Causality: Acidic cascades hide corrosion altars, holy barriers crumble to sonic resonance—every branching path mirrors your evolution
